column3: Handy early - moved up to 2nd by the 3f mark - settled 3rd at halfway - pushed into 2nd spot with 2f left - went clear approaching the final furlong - drove on to the line in comfortable style - won unchallenged

Settled handy early - moved into front around halfway - stretched clear approaching 6f out - margin narrowed inside final 2f - overtaken with a furlong left - unable to match winner's late thrust - held on for second without further gain
Sat close up early - within range past 6f - fourth at halfway - into third but unable to threaten front pair over 1f out - stayed on one dimension late to finish third
Held up towards the back - 6th at halfway - moved into contention approaching the final furlong and stayed on steadily to finish 4th
Set the pace early - lost the front spot at halfway and settled second - slipped to third with two furlongs left - unable to quicken and eased back through the field to finish fifth
Settled midfield - 5th at halfway - lost touch late and unable to quicken to finish 6th
Held up at the back - still down the field at halfway and 7th with 5f left - unable to make headway approaching the last two furlongs - held to finish 7th
Held up towards the back - 7th at halfway - dropped to 8th with 5f left - unable to close and dropped away 1 1/2f out to finish well held
Held up early - close to last at halfway - dropped away 5f out - well held at the finish

Settled in third early - slipped back to the tail past the 3f marker - squeezed for space and knocked off stride between horses 2f out - found renewed purpose under urging with a furlong to go - surged home in the closing stages to edge in front inside the final 110yds - hung on by a whisker
Went straight to front - dictated a slow gallop - company arrived 4f out - fought back and found more inside final furlong - edged out close home and unable to find more
Up with the front early - pressed the head of affairs 4f out - in contention over 1f out and going well enough - overtaken by the top two inside the final 110yds and found nil late
Settled at the back but not detached and free-going - urgency applied from 2f out - drifted left under pressure inside the final furlong - faded close home to finish 4th
Settled just behind the pace - pushed to the front approaching the final furlong - drove on to the line to score
Settled at the rear early - improved into third 2f out - pushed along entering the final furlong - moved up into second close home - stayed on but unable to reel in the winner finishing second
Pulled hard early - set the pace - ridden 2f out - displaced and edged right inside the final furlong - weakened to finish 3rd
Sat third early - urged forward with 2f remaining - slipped to the back and held no chance - finished fourth
Sat handy under strong restraint - pressed for effort inside final furlong - edged ahead right at the line
Settled midfield early fighting for control - improved into contention 2f out - hit front inside final furlong - pipped right at the line
Set the pace early - pressed for effort a furlong out then overtaken approaching the final furlong - held on for third without finding more
Settled midfield early - improved through on rails inside final furlong - stayed on to take fourth near the line
Sat close to the front pack early - moved up into second inside the last furlong marker - unable to find more late - held for fifth
Settled towards the back - found extra late inside final furlong - finished sixth beaten 3¼ lengths
Held up towards the back - shaped up late inside final furlong but no real threat - finished 7th beaten 4 lengths
Handy early - dropped away over 1f out - faded inside the final furlong to finish 8th
Held a spot in the pack early - dropped back approaching the final two furlongs - trailing badly with a furlong left - finished ninth
Settled towards the back of the pack - improved into 4th before advancing further after 3 out - moved into 2nd 2 out - hit the front close home - found extra in the drive to prevail
Settled handy early - moved into second by the 5th - hit the front approaching 3 out - overtaken at the last - fought back late - narrowly denied at the line

Took up the running - soon relinquished it after the 1st and held position just off the front - somewhat free-going early - still in contention after the 3rd - 5th before the 4th - slipped back to 7th after 3 out - made ground again from 2 out - plugged on at one speed into 3rd at the last

Settled early - slipped back before rallying into 4th - made strong progress after 3 out to lead the chasing group by 2 out - unable to threaten in front and awkward at the last - slipped to 4th and held on without extra late
Held a midfield spot early - improved into 4th with a keener effort - could not threaten those in front from 4th entering the straight - slipped to 5th and finished without further response
Held up towards the back - improved into 12th and then 4th - moved into 8th after three out - up to 7th at the last then edged into 6th at the finish
Settled towards the back of the pack - moved into 9th then up to 4th - strong move to 2nd approaching 3 out - dropped back 2 out and held on for seventh late
Held up at the back - improved into contention approaching 2 out - held in 8th and unable to quicken before the last
Held up towards the back - improved into 15th by the 4th before making some headway approaching 2 out - dropped away again in 9th before the last and beaten well home

Handy early - slipped back to midfield then fell away before the halfway point - off the pace and losing touch approaching the next - gap widened four out - rallied briefly before three out then lost momentum - well beaten at the finish
Handy early - briefly up into 3rd/4th - dropped away and pushed before 3 out - faded from there to finish last
Handy early - clumsy over first - slipped back to 8th then 4th - gave ground 4 out and faded from 3 out - finished well behind

Sat close up early - went in front approaching the 1st then overtaken by the 3rd - back in front briefly before the 4th - third at the 5th after a small error - dropped away before 3 out - well beaten at the finish

Handy early - up behind pace-setter then went in front 3rd - stretched clear soon after - gap narrowed by 5th - dropped back and overtaken before 3 out - faded fast - blundered 3 out - well beaten out the back at the finish
Settled in the pack early - moved into 6th then 4th and up to 3rd approaching 3 out - dropped back to 5th soon after - weakened before 2 out and fell
Held up early - down the field by the 4th - crept into it approaching 3 out - stayed on same pace before 2 out then slid over on the run-in
Settled handy early on eager terms - moved into second before halfway - hit the front a furlong out - pushed along entering the last furlong - pulled clear near the finish to score
Settled towards the back - short of room approaching final furlong - finished strongly to move into second close home but unable to match the winner's turn of foot
Settled in the back early - improved into contention from 2f out - briefly up to second a furlong out - eased back to finish third
Held a forward position - still in touch with the front group 2f out - drifted right approaching the final furlong and lost momentum - dropped away in the closing 110yds to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - closed a touch under a furlong out - then found little and dropped away close home
Went straight to the front - overtaken approaching final furlong and pressed for effort - lost place close home to finish sixth
Held up at the back - nudged into contention through the middle from the final furlong - lost ground close home to finish seventh
Held up in the pack - urged forward approaching 2f out then slipped to the rear inside the final furlong - faded through the closing stages to finish eighth
Settled just off the pace early - pushed along and made progress two out - moved in front inside final furlong - kept going strongly to the finish

Set the pace from the off - pushed along and under pressure a furlong out - overtaken approaching the final furlong - stayed on well but unable to reel in the winner - finished second beaten two and a half lengths
Settled just behind the pace - pushed along with 2f left - moved up into third inside the final furlong - kept on to finish third
settled in the pack early - moved into contention after 5f - pushed along 2f out but edged toward the rail - unable to find more late finishing fourth
Settled in a forward position - pushed along to try for the lead over a furlong out - faded in the closing stages to finish fifth
Settled in the pack early - dropped away past halfway - pushed along with 2f left - given time down having no impact and finished well held
Up with the front group - nudged for effort and dropped away over 2f out - faded to finish 7th
Set the pace from the off - roused along with 2f left - driven out in the closing stages to hold on
Sat behind leader - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on inside final furlong but never able to challenge
Sat behind the front group - pushed along and closed for second inside final 2f - held for late pace to finish third
Sat close to the pace early - lost ground and dropped to fourth 2f out - rallied inside final furlong to finish fourth
Hesitant start - settled among the pack early then lost placing 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 5th
Settled towards the back early - lost touch with the pace 3f from home - going wide and struggling into the finish
Sluggish start - never a factor - trailed home well beaten
Settled towards the rear - dropped away 2f out and drifted left - a distant 8th
Settled towards the back - urged forward and toiling with three furlongs left - trailing badly over the closing stages - finished ninth
Sat close to pace early - third after the third fence - moved into second before three out - went on before two out and stayed on strongly to the line
Settled close up early - drifted to 3rd through midfield stages - pushed back into 2nd before 3 out - found extra to reclaim 2nd approaching last - stayed on to be edged out by a length and a quarter

Settled midpack early - slipped towards the back before the second - moved into 4th after the fourth - slipped back again approaching 3 out - regained 4th by 2 out then found 3rd on the run-in - stayed on steadily but never able to land a blow at the finish

Held up at back early - still towards the back after 4th - improved into 5th before 3 out - made ground to 4th after 3 out - drifted wide on the home bend and slipped back to 5th before 2 out - stayed on same speed to reclaim 4th near the finish

Sent clear early and stayed in charge - clipped the third-last unsettling stride - overtaken approaching two out with a small error there - unable to find more and slid back to fourth by the final fence - faded in the run to the line finishing fifth
Held up towards the back of the pack - untidy over the third and up into 4th - moved into contention approaching 3 out - lost ground before 2 out and beaten off well held
Held up towards the back - blundered at the opening fence - fell shortly after

Went straight to the front - lost the advantage after a furlong - regained control on the turn 4f out - edged clear from the 3f marker - pressed on under pressure inside the final furlong to hold on for victory
Settled third early - moved up to second 3f out - driven from 2f out - stayed on inside the final furlong but never able to threaten the winner

Drifted right from the off - settled close to the front group - urged forward with 3f remaining - closed on the front two from 2f out - drifted left approaching the final furlong - driven out and stayed on to finish third
Went forward early - hit front after 1f - lost command on the bend 4f out - dropped away from the front two before fading into final furlong to finish fourth
Drifted left at the off - settled towards the back - dropped away from 3f out finishing well beaten
Hampered leaving stalls - held up at the back - weakened 3f out and dropped away final furlong
Held up at rear - driven into second inside final furlong before hitting front with 110yds left - challenged again but held on to prevail
Pulled hard early - tracked leader - pushed to front over 1f out - edged left inside final furlong - overtaken close home - stayed on for second
Set the pace early - pushed along 2f out then lost front spot and edged off a true line inside final furlong - faded quickly after
Sat third early - driven with two furlongs left but slipped that spot inside final furlong - unable to close and held on for fourth
Travelled keenly in front early - asked for effort inside final two furlongs - powered clear to the line
Sat handy on the inner - drifted wide and lost momentum with 2f left - found renewed energy inside the final furlong to move up to second - unable to threaten the winner late

Sat behind the front pack early - pushed along on the inner two furlongs out - moved up to second a furlong out but couldn't threaten the winner - edged out of the placing near the line finishing third
Held a forward position early - dropped from second spot with over 2f left - unable to find more late on - beaten 3 lengths in 4th
Sluggish start - settled handy in behind the front group - moved left and found extra pace inside final furlong but couldn't threaten - finished fifth
Sluggish start - settled near the back - urged along with 2f left - crept closer but couldn't threaten leaders
Dwelt at the break - trailed the field throughout - finished 7th
Held up towards the back - dropped away over final 2f - finished 8th
Settled in the pack early - moved up to third by the 5th - unable to get to the front after 3 out - held third spot before 2 out - advanced into second after 2 out - hit the front late and held on

Made the running before losing front spot before 3rd - clumsy over the 6th while up in 2nd - moved through smoothly to regain command before 2 out - clumsy again at last - overtaken late on - unable to reel in the winner

Settled towards the back of the pack - moved into 4th by the 5th - unable to trouble those in front from 3 out - found extra approaching 2 out to reach 3rd by the last - stayed on but never a factor for the win

Sat second early on - drifted left at the opener - went in front before the third - stretched clear after the fourth - margin narrowed past the sixth - overtaken before two out and dropped away rapidly after
Held up towards the back - up to 5th by halfway before losing touch and finding little from 2 out - eased away from the pack late to finish well beaten
Held up at the back - lost touch and struggling for response before 2 out - dropped away last two furlongs to finish sixth beaten well over 24 lengths

Set the early pace before being overtaken after 2f - tracked in second and travelling comfortably - urged forward to challenge 2f out - regained command approaching the final 110yds - drew clear to score

Held up in the pack early and fought for control - burst forward to hit the front after 2f - dictated a modest gallop - given a squeeze approaching final furlong - overtaken inside final 110yds and unable to respond - held on for second beaten two lengths
Dwelt at the start - back of the field early - improved to reach the front group by halfway - urged inside the final furlong - stayed on but unable to match the front two at the line
Held up in the pack - made progress through midfield from over 2f out - unable to match the front three inside the final furlong but stayed on for 4th
Close to the pace early - driven approaching 2f out - lost ground in the closing stages to finish fifth
Handy early - lost ground before halfway and pushed along approaching final furlong - stayed on same rate late to finish sixth
Held up close to the pace early - driven to keep tempo before the midpoint then dropped away - lost touch inside the final furlong - finished 7th
Held up at the back throughout - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 8th
Sat behind the only other runner - shaken up to hit the front inside the final furlong - drew away for a comfortable win
went forward eagerly early on - set the pace - pushed along and overtaken inside final furlong - stayed on but unable to reel in winner
Sat just behind the front group early - moved up to challenge 2f out and hit the front approaching the final furlong - stayed on strongly to win
Settled midfield - shifted right approaching 3f out - made ground wide 2f out - up into second inside final furlong - stayed on well but couldn't reel in winner
Held up at the back - closed strongly a furlong out to move into third - stayed on to finish third
Missed the break - settled towards the back - made progress over a furlong out - up into fourth close home and stayed on to finish 4th
Settled midfield close to rail - improved position with 2f left - held no more inside the final furlong - finished 5th beaten 5 lengths
Sat close to the pace early - hit the front approaching 2f out then lost that advantage inside the final furlong - faded near the line finishing 6th
Settled towards the back early - stayed there through the race - responded inside the last furlong without threatening the front
Held a central spot wide of the field early - squeezed for room out wide 3f from home and dropped rearward - beaten from there to finish eighth
Drifted right early - settled towards the back and drifted right again turning in - unable to close and beaten home in 9th
Went straight to the front - lost the advantage with over 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong
Tracked the pace early - pressed for effort with three furlongs left - dropped away inside the final two furlongs and beaten well home
Fought for control early - shadowed the front group before fading approaching 3f out - dropped away steadily through the closing stages

Settled early - fourth turning into straight - improved into contention approaching 3 out - moved up to challenge before 2 out and level entering final stages - went ahead on the run-in and held on strongly

Made the running from the start - stretched clear passing four out - gap narrowed approaching the second last - drawn level entering the final furlong before edged ahead and unable to fight back inside the final strides
Settled midfield - 6th passing 4 out - moved into contention after 3 out then up to 4th 2 out - unable to threaten in front approaching last - held on for 3rd

Up with the front early - nudged for effort before 5th and dropped to 4th before 2 out - jumped untidily at 2 out and last - unable to close on the principals in front - one-dimensional finish to take 4th
Settled with the pack early - 5th passing four out - pushed along in 6th after three out then unable to make headway two out - stayed on same gear to finish 5th

Sat handy behind pace early - jumped raggedly early and again mid-race - drifted wide rounding the bend before 2 out and slipped back to 5th - couldn't threaten from 2 out - held place in 6th - no response near the finish
Held up towards back of pack - dropped away after 3 out - one-paced through final two furlongs - eventually well held in 7th
Held up towards the back - hit a marker at the 5th before slipping to a lowly 8th with nothing in hand approaching 3 out - faded from 2 out to finish well beaten
Held up towards the back - never a factor - dropped away after 3 out - finished 9th
Held up towards the back and hit the 4th - never able to threaten and dropped away soon after the 3rd last - finished well beaten in 10th
Held up at the back - never a factor - dropped away after 3 out - finished well behind
Held up towards the back - blundered four out and dropped away - faded from three out finishing well beaten
Settled in the pack early - progress from 2f out to move into second with a furlong left - hit the front inside the last 110yds - pulled clear to score
Close up early - hit front before halfway - urged forward 2f out - hampered a furlong out - driven inside final furlong - overtaken close home and faded
Handy with the front group early - driven and denied room a furlong out - drifted left approaching final stages but stayed on to finish third beaten a length and a quarter

Went straight to front - lost the advantage before halfway - drifted left approaching final furlong - found a second wind and closed on the front group inside 110yds but couldn't quicken again close home
Held up at back - made progress two out - unable to match front-running group inside final furlong and dropped away close home
Settled in the pack early - driven approaching final furlong after losing touch with the pace - dropped away soon after - finished sixth beaten 9¼ lengths
Held up towards the back - short of room approaching final furlong - stayed on same rate late to finish 7th
Handy early position with front group - driven approaching final furlong then squeezed for space and dropped away - beaten well before the finish
Sluggish start - settled towards back - crept into contention 2f out - lost placing final furlong and finished 9th
Handy in the pack early - lost momentum with a furlong left and squeezed for space - dropped away quickly to finish 10th
Held up at the back - dropped away inside the final furlong - well beaten in 11th
Set the pace from the start - asked for effort inside the final furlong - stayed on to score
Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - up with the front group - moved into second 2f out - pushed along in pursuit inside final furlong and stayed on to finish second
Held up early - improved into fourth with over 3f left - driven approaching 2f out - overtaken into third inside final furlong but never able to trouble the leading two
Settled close to the front early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground final furlong to finish fourth
Held fourth early - slipped to the rear approaching 3f out and unable to threaten thereafter - finished fifth
Set the pace from the start - pushed along a furlong out - challenged inside the final furlong but kept finding more - edged clear again to score
Up with the pace early on the rail - moved into second over 1f out - full of running inside the final furlong - just denied close home
Tracked leader - driven and drifted left when dropped to third with a furlong left - stayed on at one speed to the line - finished third beaten 3 lengths

Held a midfield position early - roused into effort with three furlongs left - made progress on the inner approaching the final furlong - moved into fourth late but never a threat to the front runners
Held a midfield spot early - urged forward with 5f left before losing touch over 2f out - rallied inside the final furlong to finish fifth
Settled just off the pace - pushed along with 2f to run - unable to find more inside final furlong - finished sixth
Sluggish start - improved to track pace on the outer around 5f out - dropped back approaching final furlong and faded
Sluggish start - held up in the back markers throughout - never a threat - finished eighth
Held up towards the back - squeezed for space approaching 2f out - unable to threaten leaders - finished ninth
Held up at back of field - never able to make an impression - well held in 10th
Towards the back of the pack - toiling badly in the closing 2f - finished 11th
Sat second early - jumped in front briefly then hit front from 4th - edge cut back approaching 3 out - margin restored before final fence - kept going strongly to the line

Held up at the back - minor error 7th - swapped places 7th to 8th - up to 6th after 12th - progressed to 4th 2 out but scrappy there - into 2nd before the last - held on well run-in but no danger to winner
Settled among the pack early - moved into second before fading to 8th - rallied approaching three out and up to third by the last - held on without further gain to finish third

Just in front early but scrappy over first obstacle - shared advantage soon after - lost position after 4th - slipped to third by 8th - unable to make ground into last - stayed on same pace to finish fourth
settled around midpack early - shuffled to 5th then 8th - pushed into 4th after 3 out - slipped back to 5th 2 out unable to threaten - held no more before the last - finished 5th well held
Held up early - clumsy 3rd and soon lost touch - drifted back to 5th - narrowed the gap before 6th - dropped to 8th after 7th - shortened distance 2 out but stayed one-paced to the last
Held up towards the back of the pack - shuffled between 6th and 8th through the middle stages - improved to 5th approaching 3 out - asked for effort and found little - held on for 7th
Held up towards the back - shaken up entering the closing stages - briefly improved into 7th before 3 out - dropped away to finish 8th
Settled early - up in 4th then dropped to 8th - stumbled 4 out and slipped back - stumbled again 3 out and driven along before fading in 9th approaching two out
Settled close to the pace early - pushed forward to challenge 2f out before going clear - stayed strong to the line for the win
Hampered start - went forward and stayed under pressure early - driven along 2f out then overtaken - unable to match winner's pace inside final furlong
Sat close to front early - pushed along and gave up second spot 2f out - stayed on at one gear final furlong to finish third
Dwelt at the start - settled towards the back - pressed for effort 2f out - moved left and made progress inside the final furlong - stayed on to take fourth close home
Sat close to pace early - pushed along and dropped back 2f out - faded inside final furlong - finished fifth
Settled in the pack early - pushed along 2f out then hampered for room and slipped back - stayed on inside final furlong - never a threat late finishing sixth beaten 6 lengths
Close to the pace early - pressed for effort 2f out and eased left - unable to threaten inside final furlong - finished 7th
Handy early - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one speed inside final furlong - finished eighth beaten 6½ lengths
Settled at the back early - pushed along with 2f left and made progress inside the last furlong - weakened close home to finish 9th
Sluggish start - stayed at rear throughout - unable to trouble the leaders - finished 10th
Fought for its head early - travelling with the front group - driven approaching 2f out then faded from there
Set the pace from the start - pushed along with 2f left and pulled clear approaching the final furlong - edge narrowed close home but held on to win
Settled just off the pace - nudged into fourth approaching final 2f - closed to second inside final 110yds but couldn't get past
Held a forward position early - driven to keep tempo over 2f out - weakened in the closing stages to finish third
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - kept going late but never a factor - finished fourth
Settled in behind the pace - nudged for effort with 3f remaining - failed to get competitive - finished fifth
Settled off the pace - eased across right approaching final 2f - failed to threaten leaders - finished sixth
Shared front spot early - settled just behind pace before moving into second inside final 2f - nosed ahead approaching final furlong - stayed strong to prevail
Settled among the pack midfield - improved into contention 2f out - pressed leader entering final furlong - stayed on but narrowly outpaced at the line
Settled towards the back early - improved on the outer approaching 2f out - moved into third inside the final furlong - stayed on but couldn't reach the leading two
Settled at back of field - driven to improve wide of rivals 3f out - unable to close and stayed on at one speed inside final furlong - finished fourth beaten 2.25 lengths
Dwelt at the start - kept towards the back and made limited progress approaching the final 2f - always too far off the pace to threaten
Handy early - hit front after 1f before losing command over 1f out - dropped away in closing stages
Went straight to the front - handed up early and settled among the pack - dropped away and drifted right two furlongs out - beaten from there to finish seventh
Handy early - urged on with 3f left - dropped away over 2f out and faded from there
Sat close up early in 2nd - hit the front before the 3rd - drew clear after 4 out - stayed on strongly to score
Held slim advantage early - lost front spot approaching 3rd after an untidy jump then unable to close on top rival - stayed on in isolation for second through the finish

Held up at the back - drifted right and clipped another runner 7th - settled 4th soon after then slipped to 5th at the 8th - unable to progress after 3 out - improved into 4th before 2 out - stayed on same speed in 3rd through the run-in - finished third

Settled early in the pack - moved into 3rd before mid-race - pushed into contention but couldn't reach the front pair 3 out - held a fair 3rd before 2 out - slipped to 4th on the run-in - held to same gear to the line

Handy early - slipped back after 4th and knocked about 7th - settled 5th before edging into 4th by 8th - unable to close on the front pair 3 out - lost places to 5th before 2 out - faded from there - finished 5th well beaten

Held up towards the back early - clipped fences through mid-race and lost more ground after a heavy blunder at the 7th - drifted off the pace behind - lost more touch three out - faded before two out - well held at the finish
Settled second early - hit front approaching 3f out - eased away inside final furlongs to score comfortably
Handy early - pressed the front pair before edging right in the closing stages to move into second - stayed on to finish runner-up
Handy early on the outer - moved into second 2f out - stayed on winner's heels briefly before edging clear at 1f - lost place close home finishing third
Held up towards the back - progress into contention 3f out - squeezed for space fighting for third inside the final furlong before fading close home
Held up in the pack - shifted to the middle of the track and edged into contention over 1f out - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Held mid-pack early - squeezed for space 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish sixth
Set the pace early - lost the advantage 3f out then drifted right under pressure approaching 2f out - dropped away fast inside the final furlong to finish seventh
Held a central spot in the pack - found extra room out wide but lost ground with over a furlong left - dropped away late to finish 8th
Held up towards back - urged into contention with a furlong left - driven inside the final furlong - lost ground close home - finished ninth beaten 13 lengths
Settled at the back early - never able to land a challenge - dropped further adrift through the race - finished last of the field well behind

Dwelt at start - settled towards back - urged into contention early on - improved to second by halfway - hit front 2f from home - driven clear with a furlong left - drifted and swished under pressure inside final 110yds but kept finding more to win
Handy early - swept clear after 3f - overtaken 2f out then level again inside final furlong - stayed on into second beaten inside final 110yds

Went straight to front - crawled the early stages and lost footing rounding the first turn - overtaken after 3f - sat just behind the front group from 2f out - shared second briefly inside the last - faded to finish third
Held up towards the back - lost touch over a furlong out - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished fourth
Sat handy early - hampered on the first turn and slipped back through the field after 3f - unable to go with the leading group inside the final furlong - finished well beaten in 5th
Shared front early - tucked in behind pace-setter - asked for effort and went clear inside final furlong - held on for the win
Held up at the back - shifted middle of track 2f out - pushed along to close on the front group inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to snatch runner-up spot close home - denied by a half length
Handy with the front group early - moved into third with a furlong to run - stayed on well to finish third
Settled towards the back early - pushed along and closed inside the final furlong - claimed fourth close to the line
Handy early - driven approaching final furlong - eased back into pack and lost place late
Settled towards the back early - roused and made progress inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish sixth beaten 4¼ lengths
Held a forward position early - drifted left approaching the final furlong - lost ground rapidly close home - finished seventh beaten 4½ lengths
Shared front spot early - went clear before halfway - overtaken with a furlong left - dropped away late to finish eighth
Held up towards the back - shifted across approaching the final two furlongs - lost momentum inside the closing stages to finish well held
Handy early travelling wide of rivals - urged forward with a furlong left - faded fast inside the closing stages to finish tenth
Set the pace from the start - driven on with two furlongs left - powered clear approaching the line to score
Held up at the back - urged forward with over 2f left - quickened smartly inside the last 110yds - flew home to snatch second close to the line
Settled handy early - moved into second soon after - pressed leader inside final furlong but faded to finish third

Held a forward position early - lost touch with the front group soon after halfway - fought back into contention 2f out and drifted about while pressing for second inside the final furlong - dropped away to finish fourth
Settled towards the back - progress made inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish fifth
Close up with the front group early - lost placing 2f out - dropped away in the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f left - soon dropped away - finished 7th
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 1f left - dropped away close home - eventually beaten well clear in 8th
Held up near back - urged forward and toiling soon after halfway - dropped away inside final furlong - finished ninth well beaten
Held up at the back - under pressure with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished well beaten in 10th

Sped clear early - lost front spot briefly inside first furlong - regained command before halfway - dictated proceedings from there - kicked clear over a furlong out - kept finding more to score comfortably
Handy with pace-setters early - moved into runner-up spot inside final two furlongs - stayed on but unable to overhaul winner
Settled in the pack - improved wide into contention a furlong out then drifted right taking third close home - stayed on to finish third
Close up with the front group early - squeezed for space entering the last furlong - responded to finish strongly and claimed fourth close home
